lines.text: Eight of thirty-one astronauts in NASA's study had abnormal jugular-vein flow in flight.
Near Mars, a clot can't wait: NASA lists delays of up to 40 minutes, and no evacuation.
NASA's risk score is one snapshot. VTE Watch keeps that same score, and watches it all mission.
Scans and symptoms go in. Onboard checks flag an emergency at once, and check blood thinners before landing. Then the flight surgeon signs.
